name: Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Winter's Ballad Special Edition
tabName: Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Winter's Ballad Special Edition
introduction:
◆ Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Winter's Ballad Special Edition Event Details ◆
● During the Fashion Guide of the Cosmos: Winter's Ballad Special Edition event, Ruan Mei's outfit "Plumblossom Letter" will be available for free for a limited time.
● Claim the outfit during the event period and receive its corresponding avatar as a bonus.
● After the event has concluded, the outfit "Plumblossom Letter" will be available for purchase in the Outfit Show Window at its original price of Oneiric Shard ×1,680.
● Each outfit is limited to 1 per account and cannot be acquired repeatedly.

◆ Plumblossom Letter Outfit Details ◆
● After obtaining the "Plumblossom Letter" Outfit, you can view it from the "Character > Outfit" screen.
● Equip the Plumblossom Letter Outfit for Ruan Mei to wear during exploration and Combat.
● Ruan Mei's appearance in story scenes will not change, regardless of her equipped Outfit.
